scope: Batch 10 extraction from the untagged 2012-2013 Planeswalker's Guides to Return to Ravnica (parts 1-3), Gatecrash (parts 1-2) and Avacyn Restored (part 1). Leadership claims are as of each guide's publication (2012-2013 Ravnica / Innistrad), not present-day canon. PRELIMINARY_RESEARCH; targeted, not exhaustive; not owner approved.
